metadata.title: Finite-Scale Folding and Maximal Asymptotic Variance
metadata.abstract: Based on the recent breakthroughs by OpenAI and consequently by Binder-Ivrii-Prause-Smirnov, we develop a finite-scale folding method for the nonlinearity of a schlicht function, based on a signed critical-point count for superharmonic potentials and a quantitative target cutoff. Furthermore, we use a cylindrical root transform to reduce the logarithmic cost of access to the point at infinity. Combined with a Littlewood-Paley formula as well as dilation, the method yields the maximal asymptotic variance bound $\Sigma_{\max}^2\le1$ for the unrestricted schlicht class of normalized univalent functions.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: schlicht函数最大渐近方差的有限尺度折叠界
analysis.workSummary: 基于OpenAI及Binder–Ivrii–Prause–Smirnov的近期工作，作者为单叶函数的nonlinearity发展有限尺度folding方法，使用超调和势的带符号临界点计数及定量目标截断；柱状root变换降低到无穷远点的对数代价，结合Littlewood–Paley公式和dilation，得到不加额外限制的归一化单叶函数类最大渐近方差Σmax²≤1。
techniques: 超调和势的临界点计数
analysis.breakthrough: 作者声称把方差上界推进到不受限的schlicht类，关键在有限尺度误差及接近无穷远点的代价控制。
analysis.limitations: 此处是上界而非证明等号或确定精确极值；摘要引用OpenAI是研究背景，不能据此认定作者自行使用AI。相关新论证与外部突破的依赖须进一步核查。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
